name: VectorCraft
tagline: Vector illustration, reimagined in pure Rust
blurb: The pen, panels and shortcuts working illustrators expect, in a native app that keeps up with you.
description:
VectorCraft provides vector illustration with native speed and mathematical precision.

Includes bezier pen tool, path operations, gradient meshes, typography, SVG export, and an intuitive UI that working illustrators already know.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft.git && cd vectorcraft && cargo run --release
